questions.prompt: How many piano keys are pressed in total during a complete performance of the standard 88-key piano repertoire over a lifetime of professional practice?
reasoning: A professional pianist practises for about 3 hours every day.
Playing at an average rate of 300 notes per minute yields roughly 54000 keystrokes per day.
Over 40 years of active professional performance, this accumulates to roughly 12 million keystrokes.

questions.prompt: How many individual kernels of corn are harvested globally in a single year?
reasoning: Global annual corn production is roughly 1.2 billion metric tons.
A single metric ton of corn contains about 600000 individual kernels.
Multiplying total production by the number of kernels per ton gives about 700 trillion kernels.

questions.prompt: How many individual bricks are used in the construction of the Great Pyramid of Giza?
reasoning: The Great Pyramid has a volume of approximately 2.58 million cubic metres of stone.
The average limestone block used in its construction has a volume of just over one cubic metre.
Dividing the total volume by the average block size yields about 2.3 million individual stone blocks.
